name: Spirit Seeker Society: Chapter Callaghan
source:
Welcome to the world of the Spirit Seeker Society!

Meet Callaghan Murphy, the protagonist of S3: Chapter Callaghan! He's an upstanding goofball who actively helps his community since he dropped out of college in order to support his family. He's the vehicle that drives the pilot and I hope people grow to love him as much as I did.

[From [url=https://myuwa.itch.io/spirit-seeker-society-chapter-callaghan]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到寻灵者协会的世界！

认识卡拉汉·墨菲，S3：卡拉汉章的主角！他是一个正直的傻瓜，自从他为了养家糊口从大学退学以来，他积极帮助社区。他是驾驶飞行员的交通工具，我希望人们能像我一样爱他。

[来自[url=https://myuwa.itch.io/spirit-seeker-society-chapter-callaghan]itch.io[/url]]
